name: Tom's Adventure
author: Addicting Games
description: Embark on an epic pixelated quest in Tom's Adventure Alien Invasion, a thrilling browser game that pits you against alien foes in a retro-style platformer. As Tom, your mission is to navigate through challenging levels, facing off against a variety of quirky alien enemies along the way. Jump and dodge your way to victory in this action-packed adventure filled with nostalgic pixel art and dynamic gameplay.
